overview_description.description:
Bayzat is a technology SaaS company that provides insurance, payroll, and human resources software solutions for businesses. It helps companies provide their employees with a better experience by automating and enhancing their insurance, payroll, and HR administration.  As of today, Bayzat is helping to provide world-class employee experiences to 80,000+ employees.

The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Dubai, UAE.
